verdict.rationale: Sketch has a published pricing page that lists tier features (SSO, SCIM provisioning, permissions groups, project archiving) and a 30-day free trial. Its docs clarify one seat type: developers can inspect designs for free. The AI page states AI access requires no extra tiers, tokens, or add-ons, which makes AI-feature gating clear. However, the evidence shows no actual prices, named tiers, or a full seat-type breakdown. Missing for 10: plan names and per-seat prices, a complete seat-type matrix (Editor/Viewer/Guest costs), a tier-by-tier feature comparison, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, published plan pricing makes seat types, tiers, and AI-feature gating clear before procurement

citations.quote: There are no tokens to buy, no extra tiers, and no add-ons.
